summary: Cred and Duck analyze the current crypto market following a clear weekly range breakdown on BTC. Both agree the technical picture is bearish with BTC having lost its consolidation range around 90-94k. They identify two actionable scenarios: waiting for deep discount at 60-70k monthly support or waiting for a reclaim above 90k to confirm strength. The discussion is heavily influenced by macro concerns around Trump's tariff policies, which they view as the primary driver of current weakness. They remain constructive on longer-term crypto prospects due to improved regulatory environment but are not taking leveraged positions at current levels. XRP stands out as showing relative strength, while ETH is viewed as weak and potentially in capitulation mode on the ETH/BTC pair.
key_takeaways: BTC has broken down from its weekly range - treat it as bearish until reclaim of 90-94k or deep discount at 60-70k
No leverage interest at current levels - waiting for either extreme (deep discount or confirmed strength)
Trump tariff policy is the primary driver - markets likely to bounce hard once policy pressure eases
XRP showing impressive relative strength and expected to outperform when market recovers
ETH looking weak on both USD and BTC pairs - requires 2.2k monthly close minimum for bullish consideration
